shelters.name: Humane Society of Charlotte
shelters.description: Founded 1978, private 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Space available shelter providing low-cost spay/neuter services. Cared for 3,553 homeless animals in 2021.

shelters.name: SPCA of Wake County
shelters.description: Collaborates with partners to decrease shelter intake. 4,631 pets taken in July 2021-June 2022. Among NC's largest animal welfare organizations.

shelters.name: Asheville Humane Society
shelters.description: Only open-admission shelter in Buncombe County. Never turns away an animal in need. Finds homes for thousands annually including dogs, cats, rabbits, farm animals.

shelters.name: Brother Wolf Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Founded 2007 to provide resources and life-saving programs to build a No-Kill community.

shelters.name: Animal Protection Society of Durham
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) helping animals since 1970, managing Durham County Animal Shelter since 1990. Cares for nearly 5,000 stray, surrendered, abandoned animals annually.

shelters.name: SPCA of the Triad
shelters.description: Supporting animals in need with adoption, clinics, and more since 1994. Serves the Triad area.

shelters.name: Forsyth Humane Society
shelters.description: Among NC's largest humane societies serving Winston-Salem and Forsyth County.

shelters.name: SAFE Haven for Cats
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) no-kill shelter founded 1994. Raleigh's no-kill shelter and clinic dedicated to finding homes for homeless cats and kittens.

shelters.name: Independent Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit providing foster, adoption, and spay/neuter services in the Triangle area. Dogs and cats live in foster homes as part of the family.

shelters.name: Hope Animal Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) all-volunteer organization dedicated to rescuing and rehoming dogs in North Carolina. Every dog deserves a chance.

shelters.name: Saving Grace NC
shelters.description: Approved SECC charity for 2024. Animal rescue organization serving central North Carolina.

shelters.name: Paws for Life NC
shelters.description: Registered 501(c)(3) animal rescue dedicated to saving homeless cats and dogs through fostering, spaying/neutering, and education.

shelters.name: Carolina Paws
shelters.description: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal rescue in greater Charlotte area. Devoted to helping abandoned and abused cats and dogs find loving homes.

shelters.name: SPCA of Northeastern North Carolina
shelters.description: Serving Elizabeth City and surrounding region for decades. Caring for homeless, abandoned, and vulnerable animals.

shelters.name: Carolina Animal Rescue and Adoption
shelters.description: Animal rescue and adoption organization serving central North Carolina.

notes: Comprehensive collection of North Carolina animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Humane Society of Charlotte founded 1978. Animal Protection Society of Durham helping animals since 1970. SAFE Haven for Cats founded 1994. Coverage spans Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham, Asheville, Winston-Salem, Greensboro, and Triangle area.
